facts: Guided setup creates 3 agents and a draft atomically after confirmation. Live database shows no assigned skill IDs and no new skills after team creation.
Skill router activates existing skills by keyword overlap; their tools can expand execution tool set.
Impactful actions require approval. Monthly budget checks only apply to configured caps; guided teams have no default cap.
Second Brain absent skips corporate context; configured search failures return empty. Semantic PII judge requires API keys and fails open; OAuth-only has regex checks.
MCP client has stdio/HTTP tokenEnv but no OAuth authProvider. Official Super Agent Skill docs describe OAuth support on server.
Live UI one Send adjustment click showed Preparing version 3 then Delivery Version 3 with version 2 retained.

auto_skills.instructions: Do these facts support claiming that team creation automatically generates new skills?

criteria.unsupported: Only agents are created; skills remain existing

oauth.instructions: Do these facts support claiming KeepMind has a working Super Agent Skill OAuth connector?

criteria.supported: Client OAuth connector is present and verified
criteria.unsupported: Server support alone does not provide a client connector

guardrails.instructions: Do these facts support claiming all new teams have a spending ceiling and comprehensive PII blocking?

criteria.supported: Both protections fully enforced for all new teams
criteria.unsupported: Caps are optional and PII protection has stated limits
